welcome.title: Welcome to Ledgerline
welcome.text: A two-minute tour of where your money is and how it moves. You can leave and resume it any time from Help.

balances.title: Your balance in four parts
balances.text: Available, held after a deposit, reserved for a withdrawal, and invested. The total is always the sum of these four ledger balances.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.text: Get your personal address for each network here. Funds are credited after the blockchain confirms them.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.text: Every change to your balance, with the ledger entries behind it. You can export it as a spreadsheet.

investments.title: Investments
investments.text: Read what generates a product's return and its risks before investing. Results are added only after they are realised.

withdrawals.title: Withdrawals
withdrawals.text: You see the 3% platform fee, the network fee and the amount that arrives before you confirm.

wallets.title: Withdrawal addresses
wallets.text: Add the addresses you withdraw to. Each one is confirmed by an emailed code.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.text: Your invitation link and the rewards it has earned. Rewards are paid by the platform.

security.title: Security
security.text: Turn on two-factor authentication — it is required for withdrawals.

help.title: Help is always here
help.text: Each page has a help button that explains it. The help centre has the full guides.
